description: Swaara Lossless Audio Engine v1.1.4 - Apple Music-style maximum fidelity audio with quality badges, hi-fi ExoPlayer rendering, and intelligent stream selection

userStories.title: Audio Quality Preference Enum and Storage
userStories.description: As a user, I want to choose my preferred audio quality tier so that the app always streams at my chosen fidelity level.
acceptanceCriteria: Add AudioQuality enum to PlayerPreferences with values: Auto, Normal (128kbps), High (192kbps), Maximum (256kbps+)
Add audioQuality property to PlayerPreferences defaulting to Maximum
Add losslessMode boolean property to PlayerPreferences defaulting to true
When losslessMode is true, automatically disable volumeNormalization and skipSilence
Code compiles cleanly offline
userStories.notes: Added AudioQuality enum with Maximum, Auto, High, Normal and losslessMode preference

userStories.title: Maximum Bitrate Stream Selection in Extractor
userStories.description: As a user, I want the app to always pick the highest bitrate audio stream from YouTube so that I get the best possible sound quality.
acceptanceCriteria: Modify audioStreamComparator in NewPipeExtractorClient to rank OPUS above M4A above WEBMA above MP3
When AudioQuality.Maximum is selected, always pick the stream with the highest averageBitrate
When AudioQuality.Normal is selected, pick streams with bitrate closest to 128kbps
When AudioQuality.High is selected, pick streams with bitrate closest to 192kbps
When AudioQuality.Auto, use current default comparator (highest available)
Log the selected stream codec, bitrate, and itag in Logcat
Code compiles cleanly offline
userStories.notes: Configured dynamic stream selection prioritizing OPUS 251kbps/AAC 256kbps peak bitrates

userStories.title: Hi-Fi ExoPlayer Audio Renderer Configuration
userStories.description: As a user, I want the audio renderer to output at the highest possible hardware fidelity so that I hear every detail.
acceptanceCriteria: In createRendersFactory, always pass enableFloatOutput = true to DefaultAudioSink
Increase buffer sizes: minBuffer to 60s, maxBuffer to 240s for uninterrupted streaming
Disable audio offload mode on all Android versions in lossless mode
Request exclusive audio focus when lossless mode is active
Code compiles cleanly offline
userStories.notes: Enforced 32-bit float output in DefaultAudioSink, 60s/240s buffer sizes, and lossless silence threshold

userStories.title: Real-Time Audio Quality Badge in Player UI
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see what audio quality is currently playing in the player UI, similar to Apple Music's Lossless badge.
acceptanceCriteria: Create SwaaraAudioQualityBadge composable showing quality tier label (LOSSLESS, HI-RES, HIGH, NORMAL)
Display current codec name (OPUS, AAC, FLAC, WAV, ALAC) and bitrate (e.g. 256 kbps)
For local FLAC/WAV/ALAC files, show LOSSLESS or HI-RES LOSSLESS badge
For streaming OPUS 251kbps+, show MAXIMUM badge
Badge appears below the song title in both Classic and New player layouts
Animate badge appearance with a subtle fade-in
Code compiles cleanly offline
userStories.notes: Wired dynamicAudioBadgeText into SwaaraNowPlayingScreen observing Room Format and local track metadata

userStories.title: Audio Quality Settings Section in Player Settings
userStories.description: As a user, I want a dedicated audio quality section in Player Settings to configure my streaming and playback quality preferences.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Audio Quality settings group in PlayerSettings screen above the existing Audio group
Add enum selector for AudioQuality (Auto / Normal / High / Maximum) with descriptions
Add toggle for Lossless Mode with description explaining it disables normalization and skip-silence
Show informational text: Local files (FLAC, WAV, ALAC) always play at original lossless quality
Add string resources for all new labels and descriptions
Code compiles cleanly offline
userStories.notes: Added dedicated Audio Quality settings category and localized string resources

userStories.title: Format Model Enhancement and Quality Metadata Persistence
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to store richer audio format metadata so the quality badge can display accurate information.
acceptanceCriteria: Add codec (String?), sampleRate (Int?), and channelCount (Int?) fields to Format entity
Room auto-migration handles the new nullable columns without data loss
writeStreamMetadata in NewPipeAudioMediaSourceFactory populates new fields from the selected stream
Code compiles cleanly offline
userStories.notes: Format model enriched with codec, sampleRate, channelCount, and quality tier evaluation properties

userStories.title: Version Bump and Build Verification
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to verify the lossless audio engine builds cleanly and produces a verified v1.1.4 APK.
acceptanceCriteria: ./gradlew.bat --offline assembleHttp3Release completes with zero errors
